decks.notes: This deck focuses on using quick, evasive creatures like Spirit tokens and flyers to put pressure on the opponent early in the game. By maintaining tempo and control with counterspells and removal spells, while also drawing cards with Curious Obsession and Spectral Sailor, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they can stabilize. The inclusion of Mutavault and Brazen Borrower adds versatility and additional threats to the mix, ensuring that the deck can adapt to different situations and continue its aggressive game plan.

The deck focuses on quickly building a board presence of small, aggressive creatures to overwhelm opponents. By using cards like Thalia's Lieutenant and Luminarch Aspirant to pump up smaller creatures, followed by larger threats like Adeline, Resplendent Cathar, the deck aims to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game. With a mix of protection and evasion provided by cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and Mutavault, the deck aims to close out games quickly before opponents can stabilize. A resilient strategy that capitalizes on fast, efficient creatures to ensure victory.

The deck focuses on utilizing the Greasefang Parhelion combo to generate powerful board presence and advantage. It includes cards like Grisly Salvage and Thoughtseize for graveyard manipulation and disruption, along with cards like Esika's Chariot and Skysovereign, Consul Flagship for additional threats. The deck also includes ramp and fixing elements like Vessel of Nascency and Traverse the Ulvenwald to help assemble the combo pieces quickly. Overall, the deck aims to control the board while setting up the Greasefang Parhelion combo to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on using sacrifice effects to take advantage of the opponent's creatures while dealing direct damage through Mayhem Devil triggers. Jegantha, the Wellspring is utilized as a companion to provide additional value. The deck includes cards like Witch's Oven, Claim the Firstborn, and Fatal Push to facilitate the sacrifice strategy. With a mix of removal spells, disruption, and a strong synergistic theme, this aggressive Rakdos Sacrifice deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and control the board while chipping away at their life total.

The deck focuses on assembling the Lotus Field combo as quickly as possible using cards like Sylvan Scrying and Thespian's Stage. Once Lotus Field is in play, the deck aims to generate a large amount of mana and cast powerful spells such as Emergent Ultimatum and Omniscience. The deck also includes control elements like Pore Over the Pages and Hidden Strings to buy time until the combo is assembled. Overall, the key strategy is to ramp up quickly and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells and abilities.

The main concept of this deck is to use ramp spells and mana-fixing tools to quickly get Omnath, Locus of Creation onto the battlefield. Once Omnath is in play, the deck can generate a large amount of mana and card advantage to control the game and overwhelm the opponent. Additionally, the deck utilizes a variety of companion and versatile spells to deal with threats and disrupt the opponent's strategy, while also having a few powerful finishers like Elesh Norn and Volcanic Spite to close out the game.

This deck focuses on using Indomitable Creativity to combo off and create powerful threats on the board. It also utilizes a variety of spells and lands to support the combo strategy, while including cards like Torrential Gearhulk and Magma Opus for added versatility and power. The inclusion of Prismari Command and Divide by Zero provides interaction and disruption to control the game state, while Fable of the Mirror-Breaker offers additional combo potential. Overall, the deck aims to be creative in its approach to victory through creating unexpected and powerful board states.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp up mana quickly with cards like Llanowar Elves, Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, and Elvish Mystic, while also utilizing green devotion with cards like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. Other cards such as Karn, the Great Creator and Teferi, Who Slows the Sunset provide additional value and control options. Storm the Festival allows for card advantage and toolbox options, while Boseiju, Who Endures helps protect against counter spells. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with fast mana production and powerful green creatures.

This deck focuses on using cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Traverse the Ulvenwald to quickly assemble the combo pieces needed to bring out the powerful creature, Parhelion II. Supporting cards like Thoughtseize and Witherbloom Command help to control the opponent's hand and creatures while Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Esika's Chariot provide additional threats on the board. The deck aims to establish a dominant board presence with Parhelion II and other key cards, allowing for a strong finish against opponents in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on putting early pressure on the opponent with aggressive creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to control the battlefield. The inclusion of graveyard recursion with cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Haunted Ridge allows for sustained advantage in longer games. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and disruptive, punishing opponents for their every move.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combination of Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful synergy that can quickly overwhelm opponents. The deck includes various cards to help search for and support these key combo pieces, along with disruption and removal to control the game. The inclusion of cards like Thoughtseize and Duress help to disrupt the opponent's game plan, while cards like Esika's Chariot and Witherbloom Command provide additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and take over the game with its powerful synergies.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive plays using efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and targeted discard like Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to apply pressure early with creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester, while using cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to generate card advantage. The deck also includes powerful late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance to close out the game if needed. The goal is to keep the pressure on the opponent and overwhelm them before they can stabilize.

This deck focuses on utilizing Greasefang Parhelion, along with other supporting cards like Grisly Salvage, Vessel of Nascency, and Raffine's Informant to set up combos and control the game. It also includes disruption and protection cards like Thoughtseize, Silence, and Cling to Dust to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The main win condition is to assemble the necessary cards to create a powerful board presence with Parhelion II and Greasefang, while also controlling the game with cards like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Witherbloom Command.

The deck focuses on utilizing Niv-Mizzet Reborn as a control finisher, utilizing a diverse range of multicolor cards to have access to a variety of answers and threats. The deck also utilizes Bring to Light to search for specific answers or threats as needed. The inclusion of Yorion as a companion allows for additional card advantage and value. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the wide range of colors in the deck, allowing for flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the key concept is to control the game and out-value the opponent with a diverse array of powerful spells.

This deck focuses on putting pressure on the opponent quickly through aggressive plays and disruption. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fatal Push and Power Word Kill, while also utilizing hand disruption with cards like Thoughtseize. The creatures in the deck provide a strong offense, with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. Additionally, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional value and graveyard recursion to maintain pressure on the opponent. The deck also has a strong finisher in Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Misery's Shadow.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with efficient creatures such as Bonecrusher Giant and Lovestruck Beast, backed up by ramp creatures like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. The strategy is to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression and maintain pressure with powerful threats like Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Reckless Stormseeker. The inclusion of cards like The Akroan War and Boseiju, Who Endures provide additional disruption and resilience to removal spells. The deck aims to quickly establish board dominance and close out the game before the opponent can stabilize.
